reason: I do 1-6 homes a year and most of my work comes from referrals, so a walkthrough isn't something I'm missing right now. I don't have the capacity to think about this, and the boss decides on website stuff anyway.
objection: I build a handful of homes a year and the clients already come to me through word of mouth. I can't see $1,500 a plan for the website paying me back, and I don't have time to pull plans together and babysit another vendor.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the walkthrough of one of my own plans, built free, that a client or the boss would actually look at, plus a bulk per-plan price well under $1,500 for putting many plans on the site.
